title: 第13章 她每次都被他逼得想死
novel_title: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
content_zh:
叶闻白的别墅在学院北面，比江彻那栋还要大一些。

    安怜来过很多次，对这里的布局非常熟悉。

    一楼是客厅和餐厅，二楼是卧室和书房，三楼有一个露天的温泉池，叶闻白偶尔会带她去那里泡温泉，但每次泡着泡着就变了味。

    想到今晚可能要发生的事情，安怜手心有些出汗。

    她不是不喜欢和叶闻白亲密。

    事实上，叶闻白是三个人里最温柔的那个，从来不会弄疼她，每次都会照顾她的感受，耐心得不像话。

    但正因为温柔，才更让人难以招架。

    江彻是霸道的，想要什么就直接来，不给就亲到你给，根本不给商量的余地。

    牧子临是莽撞的，横冲直撞，每次做完安怜都要缓好几天。

    只有叶闻白，他会慢慢地、一点一点地磨，磨到她受不了主动开口求他，然后他还要问一句“怜儿想要什么，说出来哥哥就给你”。

    她每次都被他逼得想死。

    安怜叹了一口气，把那些乱七八糟的念头压下去。

    反正都已经这样了，走一步算一步吧。

    叶闻白牵着安怜走进别墅，玄关的灯自动亮起，暖黄色的光洒在两人身上。

    他弯腰从鞋柜里拿出一双棉拖，放在安怜脚边，又蹲下来替她解开鞋带。

    安怜有些不好意思，缩了缩脚：“哥哥，我自己来就行。”

    “别动。”叶闻白按住她的脚踝，轻柔地帮她把鞋脱掉，换上拖鞋。

    换完鞋，他站起来，牵着她往客厅走。

    “喝点什么？”叶闻白问，“还是老样子，热牛奶？”

    安怜点点头。

    叶闻白让她在沙发上坐下，自己去了厨房。

    安怜听到冰箱门开合的声音，然后是牛奶倒进杯子的声音，再然后是微波炉启动的嗡鸣声。

    没过多久，叶闻白端着一杯温热的牛奶走出来，递到安怜手里。

    安怜双手捧着杯子，小口小口地喝着。

    牛奶的温度刚刚好，不烫嘴也不凉，甜度也是她喜欢的。

    她忽然觉得，如果她不是同时和三个人谈恋爱，只和叶闻白一个人在一起，好像也不错。

    但很快，她就把这个危险的想法甩出了脑海。

    谈恋爱可以，结婚是万万不行的。

    “在想什么？”叶闻白的声音在耳边响起，带着一丝探究。
content_en:
Ye Wenbai's villa is to the north of the college and is larger than Jiang Che's.

    An Lian has been here many times and is very familiar with the layout here.

    The first floor is the living room and dining room, the second floor is the bedroom and study room, and the third floor has an open-air hot spring pool. Ye Wenbai occasionally takes her there to soak in the hot spring, but every time she soaks in it, the taste changes.

    Thinking of what might happen tonight, An Lian's palms became sweaty.

    It's not that she doesn't like being intimate with Ye Wenbai.

    In fact, Ye Wenbai was the gentlest of the three. He would never hurt her, he would take care of her feelings every time, and he was incredibly patient.

    But it is precisely because of its tenderness that it is even more difficult to resist.

    Jiang Che is domineering. If you want anything, you will come directly. If you don't want it, you will kiss it until you give it. There is no room for negotiation at all.

    Mu Zilin is reckless and rushes around. Every time he finishes An Lian, he has to wait for several days.

    Only Ye Wenbai would grind it slowly, bit by bit, until she couldn't bear it anymore and asked him to ask for it. Then he would ask, "Whatever Lian'er wants, tell me and my brother will give it to you."

    She was driven to death by him every time.

    An Lian sighed and suppressed those messy thoughts.

    It’s already like this anyway, let’s just take it one step at a time.

    Ye Wenbai led An Lian into the villa. The light in the entrance hall automatically turned on, and warm yellow light shone on the two of them.

    He bent down and took out a pair of cotton slippers from the shoe cabinet, placed them at An Lian's feet, and then knelt down to untie her shoelaces.

    An Lian was a little embarrassed and shrank her feet: "Brother, I can do it myself."

    "Don't move." Ye Wenbai held her ankle, gently helped her take off her shoes and put them on slippers.

    After changing his shoes, he stood up and led her towards the living room.

    "What to drink?" Ye Wenbai asked, "Still the same, hot milk?"

    An Lian nodded.

    Ye Wenbai asked her to sit down on the sofa and went to the kitchen.

    An Lian heard the sound of the refrigerator door opening and closing, then the sound of milk being poured into a cup, and then the buzz of the microwave starting up.

    Not long after, Ye Wenbai came out with a glass of warm milk and handed it to An Lian.

    An Lian held the cup in both hands and drank in small sips.

    The temperature of the milk is just right, it doesn't burn your mouth or feel cold, and the sweetness is to her liking.

    She suddenly felt that it would be good if she was not in love with three people at the same time, but only with Ye Wenbai.

    But she soon put this dangerous thought out of her mind.

    It's okay to fall in love, but it's absolutely not okay to get married.

    "What are you thinking about?" Ye Wenbai's voice sounded in his ears, with a hint of inquiry.
title_en: Chapter 13 She is driven to death by him every time
